summary: First true-3D presentation increment implemented on top of the existing 2.5D branch. The simulation and classic view are preserved. This is not a completed AAA game or a benchmark victory.

rounds.title: Recover the existing implementation
rounds.change: Created feat/ant-colony-gauntlet-3d from the saved Ant Colony 2.5D rebuild, without changing main or other games.

rounds.title: Build the read-only 3D scene
rounds.change: Added articulated caste-specific ants, queen, brood stages, beetle/spider rigs, forest dressing, cutaway terrain, shadows, cameras and responsive HUD.
rounds.evidence: 13 Node tests passed, including red-to-green snapshot, geometry and winding regression checks. Local software-WebGL fixtures exercise the real renderer; authoritative runtime and host CSP require separate integration validation.
rounds.verdict: Functional increment; geometry and material fidelity remain below the reference target.

rounds.title: Critique the first capture and revise
rounds.change: Visual inspection exposed flat creature shading. A winding regression test failed, then passed after correcting sphere, leaf and cap faces. Replaced square tunnel-boundary faces with rounded soil forms and preserved camera selection after context restoration.
rounds.evidence: Matched before/after fixture thumbnails above. Self-review is not blind or independent.
rounds.verdict: Improved light response; still NOT PASSED against the commercial reference games.

openGates: Fresh independent builder/critic workers and ultracode are unavailable: the connected coding workspace is offline. No worker review is fabricated.
Freeze and inspect exact benchmark gameplay captures; run equivalent-view blind A/B reviews. No benchmark win has been measured.
Authored high-detail creature meshes, more natural locomotion and contact animation, richer terrain, vegetation and materials.
The new 3D view has no integrated soundscape yet. Brood placement is a visual arrangement of public stage counts, not simulated individual positions.
Run the full repository suite, the real stream-host self-test and real-host Playwright/CSP checks on the published commit.
Measure peak 360-ant behavior, GPU/frame percentiles, physical mobile devices, context recovery under load and long-session resource stability.
Main-branch reconciliation remains separate: the preserved 2.5D base has diverged from main. No merge or production deployment performed.
